summary: DAY batch acquisition covers all 12 active companies and uses cumulative evidence rather than restarting the dossiers. Three repeated-attempt names now meet this lane's readiness standard (NVDA, ARM, MU); ANET is also sufficiently reproducible for Chief adjudication after conservative concentration treatment. The remaining eight have precise methodology-relevant gaps and are not allowed to consume the entire cycle.
